dialogues.speaker: Big Brother's "Letter"
dialogues.text: This note is roughly made from animal hide. Upon it, two smiling people are drawn, hand-in-hand.

dialogues.speaker: Big Brother's "Letter"
dialogues.text: The blue skies are unclouded by fog. There is only a radiant boat. "Father" and "Sister" sit on the boat, waving happily toward the shore.
